scan.summary: This is an active recreational marijuana producer license issued by the Oregon Liquor and Cannabis Commission authorizing Evergreen Botanicals, LLC to cultivate marijuana at 2210 Bailey Hill Road, Eugene, Oregon. The license is a Tier II indoor operation limited to 10,000 square feet of mature plant canopy and is valid for the period March 3, 2026 to March 2, 2027. As a permit issued by the agency itself, it contains no gaps; the owner's obligations are to meet its five stated conditions and renew before the expiration date.
scan.freshness_note: This permit was reissued on March 3, 2026 and is current. The renewal deadline approaches in approximately 5 months (February 10, 2027, which is 20 days before expiry). No updated version should be needed at this time.

conditions.title: License is valid only at the named premises and is non-transferable
conditions.evidence_expected: License location is limited to 2210 Bailey Hill Road, Eugene, Oregon 97405; any location change requires a new license application

conditions.title: License must be renewed annually before deadline
conditions.evidence_expected: Completed renewal application and renewal fee submitted to OLCC no later than February 10, 2027 (20 days before March 2, 2027 expiry); the company may continue operating after submission if the application is complete until the Commission acts on it

conditions.title: All marijuana items tracked in Cannabis Tracking System; all employees handling marijuana must hold current worker permits
conditions.evidence_expected: Cannabis Tracking System records showing all inventory tracked; employee files showing current marijuana worker permits issued by the Commission for each person handling marijuana items

conditions.title: Video surveillance meeting OAR 845-025-1450 must be maintained with 90-day recording retention
conditions.evidence_expected: Video surveillance system meeting OAR 845-025-1450 specifications; recordings retained for minimum 90 days; off-site backup in real time; equipment failure notifications to Commission within 48 hours for outages lasting 30+ minutes

conditions.title: Any ownership, premises, or financial interest changes must be reported before taking effect
conditions.evidence_expected: Documentation to Commission of any changes to ownership structure, premises modifications, or changes in persons with financial interest prior to implementation

deadlines.title: License renewal application and fee deadline
deadlines.source_line: Condition 2: 'A renewal application and the renewal fee must be received by the Commission no later than 20 days before the expiration date.' Expiration date March 2, 2027.

scan.confidence_notes: High confidence on all core permit facts—the document is an official OLCC permit and these are facts directly stated. I am certain about the license dates, number, and tier. Condition 2 (renewal deadline) is clearly stated and I calculated 20 days before March 2, 2027 as February 10, 2027. I am moderately confident about the property owner consent form requirement based on web search showing this became effective January 1, 2026 for all renewals. I am confident about the video surveillance rule reference but note that the permit's single sentence on this topic (Condition 4) does not spell out all the current detailed requirements in OAR 845-025-1450, such as the mandatory real-time off-site backup requirement and 48-hour notification requirement for equipment failures. The permit is current and does not appear to have the authorization signature filled in, which is a minor deficiency but the permit is issued and dated by the Commission so is valid. No other document gaps exist because this is a permit, not a policy—there is nothing to 'fix' in the permit itself, only conditions to meet and deadlines to observe.
